attributes.name: Pidget Tergelson
attributes.powers:
Before the encounter, examine the top card of the blessings discard pile. If the card is a blessing that has the Basic trait, the difficulty to defeat Pidget is increased by 3.

Before or after the encounter, you may banish a weapon with the Slashing trait to banish Pidget.

If defeated, you may immediately attempt to close this location.

corrections.corrected_text: Change “Blessing of the Gods” to “a blessing that has the Basic trait” on the following cards: monster Werewolf (B & C), henchman Pidget Tergelson (2).
corrections.issue: A few cards refer to Blessing of the Gods, but what if I’m using them with sets without that card?
